parsed.why: Visitor-facing immigration accommodation eases entry; tolerant society and tourism push. But no LGR/hate-crime, prison placement can mean men's cells/solitary or birth-sex checks, hospital ward refusal. Reduced, not low.
Public-decency law is used against gender expression; recent arrests and multi-year sentences mainly target trans women. Forced exams, beatings, and birth-name prison processing make custody severe.

No protections; documented border mockery and questioning without recourse, censorship of visible queer expression, conversion practices, closed venues. But no organized arrests or severe custody exposure documented.

LGR removed, no protections; documented police blackmail, law-enforcement hostility, frequent anti-LGBT attacks and legislative incitement. State and social hostility remain thin-remedy, though no criminal statute or death penalty.

Constitution names gender identity; Family Code and state trans programme signal institutional acceptance; pride grows. Police targeting of gender expression is old, enforcement contested, no current visitor restrictions documented.
